findings.comparison_with_apify: Both need one founder account step. Gumroad: 10%+$0.50 direct, MoR tax handling (relevant to Quebec GST/QST question), optional Discover marketplace at 30% for discovery; payout threshold USD 100. Apify PPE: 80% of event revenue minus platform costs, free-plan users excluded (L6/L7). Gumroad fits one-off digital deliverables; Apify fits per-use utilities.

condition: Pursue only if the founder chooses to create/authorize a dedicated Gumroad seller account (founder identity, Stripe KYC, CAD bank account). Do not price the existing free Shopify sample until a classified request or download signal exists; the USD 100 payout minimum means a single small sale cannot become verified revenue.
smallest_founder_step: Create or designate a Gumroad seller account for GlobalLand in the founder's name, complete Payments Settings with a Canadian CAD bank account, and tell agents only the public profile URL (no credentials). Agents would then prepare one digital product package and listing copy for independent review; the founder (or an authorized integration) uploads it.
